name: gamentic
description: Gamentic game engine, exposed as an Anna Executa. One tool, `request`, replays an HTTP-style call against the engine.

tools.name: request
tools.description: Invoke a game-engine operation. Mirrors the orchestrator's REST surface: pass the path, the HTTP method, and an optional JSON body.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: HTTP verb: GET | POST | PATCH | DELETE.
